policy: Bounded Agent 3 packet joining Definition Workbench planning rows to usage-navigation occurrence rows by token key or normalized form. It carries usage links, source/license/context metadata, and route IDs only; it does not publish source excerpts as definitions, copy route payloads, rank definitions, select visible answers, translate, or make publication claims.

definition_sample_contract.review_policy: This machine builder never emits review_status=verified. Verified is reserved for future reviewed lexical authority outside this sample contract.
definition_sample_contract.answer_role_policy: Answer cards are counted only when answer_eligible=true and answer_role=answer. All other route cards remain evidence-only counts in this sample.
definition_sample_contract.source_license_policy: Source/license completeness is checked against route card source_rows. This sample emits only completeness flags, source-family aggregates, route-family aggregates, and card IDs.
definition_sample_contract.multi_answer_policy: multi_answer=true when more than one distinct answer definition hash exists. These rows retain conflicting status as a warning, not a hidden winner.

checks.detail: sample rows with usage links 0; usage tokens not in sample 1

current_overlap.note: The current 200-row Definition Workbench sample does not include the current selected Agent 3 usage token if sample_rows_with_usage_links is 0. This is a planning gap, not a usage evidence failure.
